heading.title: Parties to Notes, Bills and Cheques.

article.title: Liability of prior parties to holder in due course.
article.content: Every prior party to a negotiable instrument is liable thereon to a holder in due course until the instrument is duly satisfied.
article.html:
36Liability of prior parties to holder in due course.

Section 36 · Chapter III · page 13 of the Act

Every prior party to a negotiable instrument is liable thereon to a holder in due course until the instrument is duly satisfied.
